# Uploading and Preparing the Data

```{r}
# uploading
sites_ever_treated <- read_csv('../data/output/intersection_intervention_table_ever_treated_2018-2021_SENSITIVITY.csv', show_col_types = FALSE)
# meant to handle large datasets
sites_ever_treated <- as.data.table(sites_ever_treated)


sites_ever_treated_big <- read_csv('../data/output/intersection_intervention_table_ever_treated_2015-2022.csv', show_col_types = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# EDA for old vs new data
intervention_cols <- c(
  "turn_traffic_calming_post",
  "leading_pedestrian_interval_post",
  "enhanced_crossing_post",
  "speed_humps_post",
  "street_improvement_project_post",
  "street_improvement_corridors_post",
  "signal_retiming_post",
  "slow_zones_post",
  "speed_limit_post"
)

# count unique treated intersections 
counts_original <- sites_ever_treated_big %>%
  group_by(intersection_id) %>%
  summarise(across(any_of(intervention_cols), ~ max(.x, na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
  summarise(across(any_of(intervention_cols), ~ sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), 
               names_to = "Intervention", 
               values_to = "Original_Sample_Count")

counts_sensitivity <- sites_ever_treated %>%
  group_by(intersection_id) %>%
  summarise(across(any_of(intervention_cols), ~ max(.x, na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
  summarise(across(any_of(intervention_cols), ~ sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE))) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), 
               names_to = "Intervention", 
               values_to = "Sensitivity_Sample_Count")

comparison_table <- counts_original %>%
  left_join(counts_sensitivity, by = "Intervention") %>%
  mutate(
    Percent_Retained = round((Sensitivity_Sample_Count / Original_Sample_Count) * 100, 1)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Original_Sample_Count)) # Sort by most common to least common
print(comparison_table)
```

```{r}
# scale variables
# the incidence ratio of these variables will now represent the change in odds for a *one standard deviation* increase in the original predictor
# nyc_metro_pop not included to to multicollnearity

sites_ever_treated <- sites_ever_treated %>%
  mutate(
    scaled_summonses = scale(citywide_traffic_summonses),
    scaled_traffic_volume = scale(nyc_metro_dvmt),
    scaled_pop_density = scale(pop_per_sqmi),
    scaled_time = scale(time)
  )
```

# Fixed effects for intersections

```{r}
model_fixed <- fepois(
  pedestrian_death_or_injury ~ 
    turn_traffic_calming_post +
    leading_pedestrian_interval_post +
    enhanced_crossing_post +
    speed_humps_post +
    street_improvement_project_post +
    street_improvement_corridors_post +
    signal_retiming_post +
    #slow_zones_post +
    speed_limit_post +
    covid_2020 + 
    scaled_summonses + 
    scaled_traffic_volume + 
    ns(scaled_pop_density, df = 2) +        
    scaled_time | 
    intersection_id,
  data = sites_ever_treated
)

summary(model_fixed)

check_collinearity(model_fixed)
```

```{r}
# exploring model_fixed since it is the final chosen model

# Load broom (fixest works with broom automatically)
library(broom)

# Tidy the model output
# fixest automatically clusters SEs by the fixed effect (intersection_id)
irr_results_tidy <- tidy(model_fixed, 
                         conf.int = TRUE,      # Calculate confidence intervals
                         exponentiate = TRUE,  # Exponentiate to get IRRs
                         se = "cluster") %>%   # Explicitly request clustered SEs
                   select(term, estimate, conf.low, conf.high, p.value)

# Print the clean results table
print(irr_results_tidy)
```

```{r}
# visualizing results
library(plotly)
library(dplyr)
library(fixest)

# extract from the summary table to ensure row counts match (ignoring theta)
model_summary <- summary(model_fixed, se = "cluster")$coeftable

# extract columns by index to be safe (1=Est, 2=SE, 4=Pval)
coef_point_estimates <- model_summary[, 1]
model_se <- model_summary[, 2]
p_values_model <- model_summary[, 4]

# compute z-scores 
z_scores <- coef_point_estimates / model_se

# compute confidence intervals (normal approximation)
ci_lower <- coef_point_estimates - 1.96 * model_se
ci_upper <- coef_point_estimates + 1.96 * model_se

# define custom order
custom_order <- c(
  #"scaled_time",
  # "ns(scaled_pop_density, df = 2)1", 
  # "ns(scaled_pop_density, df = 2)2",
  #"scaled_traffic_volume",
  #"scaled_summonses",
  #"covid_2020",
  "speed_limit_post",
  "slow_zones_post",
  "street_improvement_corridors_post",
  "street_improvement_project_post",
  "signal_retiming_post",
  "speed_humps_post",
  "enhanced_crossing_post",
  "leading_pedestrian_interval_post",
  "turn_traffic_calming_post"
)

# create percent change data frame
percent_change_df <- data.frame(
  term = names(coef_point_estimates),
  percent_change = 100 * (exp(coef_point_estimates) - 1),
  lower_ci = 100 * (exp(ci_lower) - 1),
  upper_ci = 100 * (exp(ci_upper) - 1),
  p_value = p_values_model
) %>%
  # Filter to only include terms in the custom order
  filter(term %in% custom_order) %>%
  mutate(
    significant = ifelse(p_value < 0.05, "Significant", "Not Significant"),
    term = factor(term, levels = custom_order)
  )

# set factor levels for y-axis ordering
percent_change_df$term <- factor(percent_change_df$term, levels = custom_order)

# create interactive Plotly chart
p <- plot_ly(data = percent_change_df) %>%
  add_segments(
    x = ~lower_ci,
    xend = ~upper_ci,
    y = ~term,
    yend = ~term,
    color = ~significant,
    colors = c("Significant" = "blue", "Not Significant" = "red"),
    showlegend = FALSE,
    hoverinfo = "none",
    line = list(width = 2)
  ) %>%
  add_markers(
    x = ~percent_change,
    y = ~term,
    color = ~significant,
    colors = c("Significant" = "blue", "Not Significant" = "red"),
    marker = list(size = 10),
    text = ~paste0(
      "Percent Change: ", round(percent_change, 2), "%<br>",
      "95% CI: (", round(lower_ci, 2), "%, ", round(upper_ci, 2), "%)<br>",
      "p-value: ", round(p_value, 4)
    ),
    hoverinfo = 'text'
  ) %>%
  layout(
    title = "Pedestrian Deaths and Injuries",
    subtitle = "Fixed Effects Negative Binomial; SEs clustered by Intersection",
    xaxis = list(
      title = "Percent Change", 
      zeroline = TRUE, 
      zerolinecolor = 'black', 
      zerolinewidth = 1
    ),
    yaxis = list(
      title = "Fixed Effect", 
      categoryorder = "array", 
      categoryarray = rev(custom_order)
    ),
    legend = list(title = list(text = "Significance")),
    colorway = c("blue", "red")
  )

# show the plot
p
```

# Boostrapped CIs

```{r}
# Robust Bootstrapping Function for fixest::fenegbin
cluster_bootstrap_fixest <- function(model, data, cluster_var, R = 500, secs_per_iter = NULL) {
  
  if (!is.null(secs_per_iter)) {
    total_hours <- secs_per_iter * R / 3600
    cat("Estimated total time:", round(total_hours, 2), "hours\n")
  }
  
  # 1. Setup Clusters
  clusters <- unique(data[[cluster_var]])
  n_clusters <- length(clusters)
  
  # 2. Prepare Storage
  # We grab the formula directly from the original model
  model_formula <- model$fml
  
  # Get original coefficient names to set up the matrix
  original_coefs <- coef(model)
  coef_names <- names(original_coefs)
  
  coefs_mat <- matrix(NA, nrow = R, ncol = length(original_coefs))
  colnames(coefs_mat) <- coef_names

  # 3. Bootstrap Loop
  for(i in 1:R) {
    if(i %% 50 == 0) cat("Bootstrap iteration:", i, "\n")

    # A. Resample Clusters
    sampled_clusters <- sample(clusters, n_clusters, replace = TRUE)
    
    # B. Construct Bootstrapped Dataset
    # We rely on data.table/split logic implicitly here via lapply for speed/safety
    boot_data <- do.call(rbind, lapply(sampled_clusters, function(cl) {
      data[data[[cluster_var]] == cl, ]
    }))

    # C. Refit Model (Using direct function call, not update)
    boot_model <- tryCatch({
      fixest::fenegbin(model_formula, data = boot_data, nthreads = 1) # Force single thread inside loop to prevent overhead
    }, error = function(e) {
      # Print error only for the first iteration to help debugging
      if(i == 1) message(paste("Iteration 1 Failed:", e$message))
      return(NULL)
    })

    # D. Store Results Safely (Matching by Name)
    if (!is.null(boot_model)) {
      try_coefs <- tryCatch(coef(boot_model), error = function(e) NULL)
      
      if(!is.null(try_coefs)) {
        # Find which coefficients exist in both (handling dropped vars)
        common_vars <- intersect(names(try_coefs), coef_names)
        
        # Assign only the matching columns
        coefs_mat[i, common_vars] <- try_coefs[common_vars]
      }
    }
  }

  # 4. Post-Processing
  
  # Standard Errors
  bootstrap_se <- apply(coefs_mat, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # Percentile CIs
  ci_lower <- apply(coefs_mat, 2, function(x) quantile(x, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE))
  ci_upper <- apply(coefs_mat, 2, function(x) quantile(x, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE))

  # P-values
  p_values <- sapply(1:length(original_coefs), function(j) {
    est <- original_coefs[j]
    boot_vals <- coefs_mat[, j]
    
    # Count valid runs
    valid_runs <- sum(!is.na(boot_vals))
    if(valid_runs < 10) return(NA) # Return NA if too few successful runs
    
    opposite_sign <- mean(boot_vals * est < 0, na.rm = TRUE)
    min(1, opposite_sign * 2)
  })

  # Convergence Rate
  convergence_rate <- 1 - (sum(apply(coefs_mat, 1, function(x) all(is.na(x)))) / R)

  return(list(
    coefs = coefs_mat,
    bootstrap_se = bootstrap_se,
    ci_lower = ci_lower,
    ci_upper = ci_upper,
    p_values = p_values,
    convergence_rate = convergence_rate,
    total_iterations = R
  ))
}

# --- RUN THE BOOTSTRAP ---

# 1. Run 1 iteration to check for errors and time
start_time <- Sys.time()

cat("--- Test Run (1 Iteration) ---\n")
test_results <- cluster_bootstrap_fixest(
  model = model_fixed, 
  data = sites_ever_treated, 
  cluster_var = "intersection_id", 
  R = 1
)

end_time <- Sys.time()
secs_per_iter <- as.numeric(difftime(end_time, start_time, units = "secs"))
cat("Seconds per iteration:", round(secs_per_iter, 2), "\n")

# Check if test run worked
if(test_results$convergence_rate == 0) {
  stop("Test run failed to produce any coefficients. Check the error message above.")
}

# 2. Run Full Bootstrap (If test passed)
cat("--- Starting Full Bootstrap ---\n")
boot_results <- cluster_bootstrap_fixest(
    model = model_fixed,
    data = sites_ever_treated,
    cluster_var = "intersection_id",
    R = 1000, 
    secs_per_iter = secs_per_iter
)

# 3. Check results
print(boot_results$convergence_rate)
print(head(boot_results$coefs))
```

```{r}
library(plotly)
library(dplyr)

# --- STEP 1: DATA PREPARATION ---

# 1. Extract Data
# Ensure we match everything by name so the order doesn't get mixed up
coefs <- coef(model_fixed)
se    <- boot_results$bootstrap_se

# Keep only coefficients that exist in both
common <- intersect(names(coefs), names(se))
coefs <- coefs[common]
se    <- se[common]

# 2. Compute Z-scores, P-values, and CIs (Normal Approximation)
# We calculate P-values here to ensure they match the Visual CIs perfectly
z_scores <- coefs / se
p_values <- 2 * (1 - pnorm(abs(z_scores)))
ci_lower_log <- coefs - 1.96 * se
ci_upper_log <- coefs + 1.96 * se

# 3. Build Data Frame
plot_df <- data.frame(
  term = names(coefs),
  percent_change = 100 * (exp(coefs) - 1),
  lower_ci = 100 * (exp(ci_lower_log) - 1),
  upper_ci = 100 * (exp(ci_upper_log) - 1),
  p_value = p_values
)

# --- STEP 2: ORDERING AND FACTORS  ---

custom_order <- c(
  "scaled_time",
  "scaled_traffic_volume",
  "scaled_summonses",
  "street_improvement_corridors_post",
  "street_improvement_project_post",
  "signal_retiming_post",
  "speed_humps_post",
  "enhanced_crossing_post",
  "leading_pedestrian_interval_post",
  "turn_traffic_calming_post"
)

plot_df_filtered <- plot_df %>%
  filter(term %in% custom_order) %>%
  mutate(
    # 1. Define Significance Label
    significant_label = ifelse(p_value < 0.05, "Significant", "Not Significant"),
    
    # 2. Force Factor Levels
    significant = factor(significant_label, levels = c("Significant", "Not Significant")),
    
    # 3. Apply Term Ordering
    term = factor(term, levels = custom_order)
  )

# --- STEP 3: PLOT ---

p <- plot_ly(data = plot_df_filtered) %>%
  add_segments(
    x = ~lower_ci,
    xend = ~upper_ci,
    y = ~term,
    yend = ~term,
    color = ~significant, # Maps to the factor we fixed above
    colors = c("Significant" = "blue", "Not Significant" = "red"), # Explicit mapping
    showlegend = FALSE,
    hoverinfo = "none",
    line = list(width = 2)
  ) %>%
  add_markers(
    x = ~percent_change,
    y = ~term,
    color = ~significant,
    colors = c("Significant" = "blue", "Not Significant" = "red"),
    marker = list(size = 10),
    text = ~paste0(
      "<b>Term:</b> ", term, "<br>",
      "<b>% Change:</b> ", round(percent_change, 2), "%<br>",
      "<b>95% CI:</b> (", round(lower_ci, 2), "%, ", round(upper_ci, 2), "%)<br>",
      "<b>P-value:</b> ", round(p_value, 4)
    ),
    hoverinfo = 'text'
  ) %>%
  layout(
    title = "Pedestrian Deaths and Injuries",
    subtitle = "Fixed Effects NB Estimates with Cluster-Bootstrap CIs",
    xaxis = list(
      title = "Percent Change in Injuries", 
      zeroline = TRUE, 
      zerolinecolor = 'black', 
      zerolinewidth = 1
    ),
    yaxis = list(
      title = "", 
      categoryorder = "array", 
      categoryarray = rev(custom_order)
    ),
    legend = list(title = list(text = "Significance")),
    margin = list(l = 150)
  )

p
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

# 1. Define the specific variables of interest 
intervention_vars <- c(
  "street_improvement_project_post",
  "signal_retiming_post",
  "leading_pedestrian_interval_post",
  "enhanced_crossing_post",
  "street_improvement_corridors_post",
  "speed_humps_post",
  "turn_traffic_calming_post"
)

# 2. Extract Data
# Point Estimates from the Fixed Effects Model
beta <- coef(model_fixed)[intervention_vars]

# Standard Errors from the Bootstrap Results
se_boot <- boot_results$bootstrap_se[intervention_vars]

# 3. Perform Calculations
# Step A: Z-scores & P-values (Wald test using Bootstrap SE)
z_score <- beta / se_boot
p_val   <- 2 * (1 - pnorm(abs(z_score)))

# Step B: IRR Calculations
# Calculate CIs on Log scale first
lower_log <- beta - 1.96 * se_boot
upper_log <- beta + 1.96 * se_boot

irr_est   <- exp(beta)
irr_lower <- exp(lower_log)
irr_upper <- exp(upper_log)

# Step C: Percent Change Calculations
pct_est   <- 100 * (irr_est - 1)
pct_lower <- 100 * (irr_lower - 1)
pct_upper <- 100 * (irr_upper - 1)

# 4. Construct the Table
results_table <- data.frame(
  Intervention = names(beta),
  
  # Column 1: IRR
  IRR = sprintf("%.3f", irr_est),
  
  # Column 2: 95% CI for IRR
  IRR_CI = paste0("(", sprintf("%.3f", irr_lower), ", ", sprintf("%.3f", irr_upper), ")"),
  
  # Column 3: % Change
  Percent_Change = sprintf("%.2f%%", pct_est),
  
  # Column 4: 95% CI for % Change
  Pct_Change_CI = paste0("(", sprintf("%.2f", pct_lower), "%, ", sprintf("%.2f", pct_upper), "%)"),
  
  # Column 5: P-value
  P_Value = sprintf("%.4f", p_val)
)

# Clean up the Intervention Names for display (remove underscores, Title Case)
results_table$Intervention <- tools::toTitleCase(gsub("_post", "", results_table$Intervention))
results_table$Intervention <- gsub("_", " ", results_table$Intervention)

# 5. Render the Table
results_table %>%
  kable(
    format = "html", 
    caption = "<b>Impact of Interventions: Fixed Effects NB Estimates with Bootstrap CIs</b>",
    align = c("l", "c", "c", "c", "c", "c")
  ) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"), full_width = F) %>%
  column_spec(1, bold = TRUE) %>% # Make intervention names bold
  column_spec(6, bold = ifelse(as.numeric(p_val) < 0.05, TRUE, FALSE)) # Highlight significant p-values
```
